symptom: Webhook deliveries return 401 after credential rotation

diagnostics.check: Confirm the active credential identifier matches the webhook configuration
diagnostics.requestedData: Last four characters of the credential identifier and rotation timestamp
diagnostics.expectedResult: Configured identifier matches the active credential

diagnostics.check: Compare signature algorithm header before and after rotation
diagnostics.requestedData: Sanitized header names and algorithm value; no secret or full payload

responseDraft.message: We can narrow this without sharing secrets. Please confirm the rotation time, the last four characters of the active credential identifier, and the sanitized signature algorithm header.

escalation.reason: Escalate if the configured identifier matches but post-rotation signatures remain rejected
